purpose: Outcome-blind paired development qualification of the frozen v15 system, constraint-driven operation treatment, and terminal evaluator reach under corrected output and provider acquisition boundaries.

shared_boundary.provider_acquisition: two bounded JSONDecodeError retries with per-attempt accounting

matched_primitive_limits.matching_basis: primitive limits; USD is neither a matching variable nor a scientific outcome

primary_outcomes: scientifically eligible paired runs and paired Official Boolean outcomes
internal-pass and natural Official-evaluator reach by method
paired Official success difference when both sides are eligible and Boolean
output completion and provider acquisition boundary invariants

boundary_invariants.length_finish: usage-bearing length response is completed usage and candidate-policy-output, never request error or policy exception
boundary_invariants.provider_recovery: each parse retry consumes a request; a successful recovery has matching retry/error accounting; exhaustion is provider-acquisition-failure
boundary_invariants.budget_terminal: online budget exhaustion is episode-budget-exhausted with exact scope

qualification_rule.complete_batch: Run all five frozen pairs unless a shared boundary invariant fails or the operator interrupts execution.
qualification_rule.insufficient_terminal_reach: Report the batch as terminal-reach insufficient and use only failure decomposition; do not estimate method effectiveness.
qualification_rule.paired_comparison: Use only pairs where both runs are scientifically eligible and return Boolean Official outcomes.
qualification_rule.shared_boundary_failure: Finish the active pair, close Q11, consume all selected identities, and repair only with synthetic or consumed evidence.
qualification_rule.provider_acquisition_exhaustion: Record infrastructure Unknown, censor the pair, continue the frozen schedule, and do not retry or replace the case.

adaptation_policy.pre_episode_acquisition_failure: one audited same-identity retry only when model, candidate, environment, command, evaluator, and method information are all zero
adaptation_policy.terminal_evaluator_infrastructure_failur: one evaluator-only retry of the identical script with zero new model calls
adaptation_policy.host_suspension: stop and classify affected or orphaned positions as scientifically ineligible without overwrite
adaptation_policy.other_infrastructure_failure: record Unknown and censor the pair without retry

claim_scope: development terminal-reach and paired method qualification only
